name: American University - Undergraduate
description: The main campus of American University spans 90 acres on Ward Circle, in the Spring Valley neighborhood of Northwest D.C. in Washington. American University's undergraduate program was tied for 76th overall among "national universities" in U.S. News & World Report's 2021 rankings, tied for 25th in "Best Undergraduate Teaching", tied for 35th in “Most Innovative Schools”, and 82nd in "Best Value Schools".
